# Flamestone American Grill

> American Grill in Oldsmar, Florida. Steaks grilled over an open flame, guacamole made tableside in a molcajete, and a polished room on Tampa Road that guests call a hidden gem.

- Phone: (813) 814-7778
- Address: 4009 Tampa Rd, Oldsmar, FL 34677
- Areas: Oldsmar, Safety Harbor, Westchase, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Tableside guacamole and starters; Steaks, ribs and seafood; Bar, wine and Sunday brunch
- Rating: 4.5 from 2543 Google reviews
